track: The Open Gate III - The Gate Swings Open
voice_direction: mature male, warm, low, unhurried, near-monotone, intimate; speed ~0.85; let ellipses breathe

segments.text: This program is hypnotic in nature... and is created for relaxation, and personal growth. Never listen in a moving vehicle... or at any time when you need your full, awakened attention.

For if so many open doors... have found you standing still... watching the light change... rehearsing the first step... until the moment... quietly... closed again... while your feet... knew the way... all along...
...then this is your time to sit, or lie back, more comfortably relaxed.
And you already know the way... along the dew-soft path... at first light... the old warm wall... the wild roses... the iron gate... standing open... as it stands... open now...
But today... you may notice... what lies beyond the gate... the road... winding golden... through the morning mist... and every bend of it... lit...
The air beyond the wall... smells of distance... of fields you have never walked... of towns still waking... of something already yours... waiting... to be met halfway...
For the garden was never the whole of it... the garden is where you learned to receive... and the road... is where receiving... becomes walking...
And as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you may feel the ground beneath you... firm... certain... as if the path itself... were holding you up...
Mist parting slowly... birdsong behind you... the road ahead... turning gold... one stone... at a time...
And with each easy breath... your body grows lighter... readier... like a horse at the gate... like a hand on a latch... like a bow... already drawn...
For your inner, wiser self... has never once hesitated... it rises... it walks... it arrives... while doubt is still... lacing its boots...
And here... at the open gate... the whole question... is only... one step...
For an open door... is an invitation... and invitations... have a season...
You may feel it now... the body leaning... before the mind agrees...
Perhaps... the first step... is never decided... only... taken...
For the light is good... and the light... is now...
A yes... rises in your chest... like morning... rises in the sky...
And you might be pleasantly surprised... how the road holds you... once you are on it...
The foot that steps... finds the stone... the hand that reaches... finds the door...
For doubt speaks slowly... and you... move first...
You need not see the whole road... only the next... golden... yard...
Every step you take... teaches the road... to meet you... sooner...
An opportunity passes once... as a stranger... greet it... and it returns... as an old friend...
For the gate opens... for the one... who walks...
And when you say yes... the mist parts a little... the light warms a little... the way... grows a little clearer...
Your body knows the moment... the way the roses... know the dawn...
You rise... before the excuse... you walk... before the worry... you arrive... before the doubt...
For action is not force... it is timing... and your timing... is the morning...
And every road you walk... leads to another gate... and every gate... opens... for you...
For you have always been the traveler... and the road... has always been yours...
And now... as the morning climbs higher... you can bring something back with you...
For the step you practiced here... was never imaginary... your body remembers... how it feels... to go...
And when an opening appears, from this day forward... you move.
When the light is good... you walk.
When a yes rises in you... you say it.
When doubt begins its sentence... you are already... walking.
Each day the road grows clearer... each step... more your own...
For you are... the traveler of your own life... and the gate... was never locked.
